```{r}
library(here) 
library(tidyverse)
library(modelr)
library(zoo)

trips_per_day <- read_tsv('trips_per_day_2015.tsv')
weather_2015 <- read_csv('weather_2015.csv')

weather_2015 <- weather_2015 %>%
rename(ymd = DATE) %>%
mutate(ymd = ymd(ymd))

trips_2015 <- trips_per_day %>%
    left_join(weather_2015, by = 'ymd')

trips_2015 <- trips_2015 %>%
    rename_with(tolower)

# (1) clean holiday data for only 2014 data and only pull out the dates 
holidays <- read_csv(here('week4', 'holidays.csv'), col_names=c('index', 'date', 'holiday'))
holidays <- holidays %>% 
    filter(grepl('^2015-', date)) %>% 
    pull(date)

# (2) clean wind data by averaging the data between stations
winds_raw <- read_csv(here('week4', 'winds.csv'))
winds <- winds_raw %>% 
    group_by(DATE) %>% 
    summarize(
        average_winds=mean(AWND)
    ) %>% 
    rename(ymd=DATE)

trips_2015 <- trips_2015 %>% 
    mutate(day_of_week = weekdays(ymd)) %>%
    mutate(is_holiday = (ymd %in% holidays)) %>%
    left_join(winds, by = 'ymd')

trips_2015 %>% 
    filter(is.na(average_winds)) %>% 
    select(ymd)

trips_2015$average_winds <- na.approx(trips_2015$average_winds, na.rm = FALSE)

trips_2015 <- trips_2015 %>% 
    filter(grepl('^2015-', ymd)) %>% 
    mutate(
        did_snow = (snow != 0),
        did_rain = (prcp != 0),
        sig_snwd = (snwd != 0)
    ) %>% 
    mutate(
        tmax = tmax * 0.1
    )
```

```{r}
load('citibike_model_5.Rdata')

predictions <- predict(model6, newdata = trips_2015)
actual <- trips_2015$num_trips
rmse <- rmse(predictions, actual)
rmse

rmse <- function(y, y_hat) {
    sqrt(mean((y_hat - y)^2))
}

mse <- function(y, y_hat) {
    (rmse(y, y_hat))^2
}

r.squared <- function(y, y_hat) {
    y.bar = mean(y)
    1 - (mse(y, y_hat)/mse(y, y.bar))
}

rmse(trips_2015$num_trips, predict(model6, trips_2015))
r.squared(trips_2015$num_trips, predict(model6, trips_2015))

```
